name: Guldseth Cherry Orchard
description: Guldseth Cherry Orchard is an apple orchard in Cherry Valley, CA. Visitors come for Apples, Peaches, Nectarines, Apricots, and Plums, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
